candidates.description: Retrieve a bounded year range from NOAA GML’s fixed raw global annual atmospheric N2O mole-fraction increase table, including provider-reported uncertainty.
candidates.license: Wrapper BUSL-1.1; NOAA GML source-use page requests fair credit for its measurements and data.
candidates.maintainer: Ignition repository maintainers; this field confers no NOAA, Owner, emissions-accounting, or scientific authority.
good_for: Retrieve NOAA GML provider-reported global annual atmospheric N2O mole-fraction increase and uncertainty in ppb for a bounded inclusive year range from the fixed raw table only.
Record one raw-table response digest, retrieval time, HTTP metadata, and explicit missing-year or acquisition status for source review.
not_for: Comparing the rendered page against the raw table; use the two-surface N2O comparator when both surfaces and their differences are required.
Estimating N2O emissions, identifying emitting sectors, attributing causes, or making a scientific conclusion.
Arbitrary URLs, station-level/monthly observations, credentials, or unrestricted date ranges.
Treating a missing year as zero or a response digest as source authentication.
only_if: The caller explicitly selects this experimental tool for a bounded, read-only NOAA GML task; no router invokes it automatically.
Network retrieval requires a separate per-invocation --allow-public-network flag and is limited to the fixed HTTPS path on gml.noaa.gov.
counterindicated_when: Public network access is disallowed or the task requires no contact with NOAA GML.
The task requires contemporaneous page/raw comparison, emissions inventories, source attribution, causal analysis, station data, or independent method validation.
A pinned historical response is required and the live response is not archived.
accepted_input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with schema_version toolbox-noaa-n2o-annual-growth-lookup-input-r0 and exactly integer start_year/end_year (2001–2100 inclusive; at most 50 years).
output_types: Provider-reported annual atmospheric N2O mole-fraction increases and stated uncertainties in ppb from the fixed raw table only, with explicit FOUND, PARTIAL_DATA, or NO_MATCH status.
One fixed raw-table receipt with retrieval time, HTTP metadata, response byte count and SHA-256, explicit request count, and claim ceiling; raw response is not retained.
side_effects: When explicitly invoked with --allow-public-network, sends exactly one HTTPS GET to the fixed NOAA GML N2O raw-table URL; year bounds are applied locally and no caller URL or private identifier is transmitted.
Writes a bounded selected-record JSON receipt to stdout and errors to stderr; does not retain the raw response or write repository files.
Rejects redirects, non-text content, oversized or slow responses, malformed headers/tables, duplicate/out-of-order years, and invalid numeric rows as explicit outcomes.

estimated_cost.basis: Exactly one fixed public HTTPS GET is attempted per explicitly opted-in invocation; monetary cost, stable latency, source availability, and parser reliability are not measured.

alternatives.reason: This candidate has a different species or surface scope and does not replace the requested task contract.
This candidate has a different species or surface scope and does not replace the requested task contract.
Same-gas raw-only lookup minimizes requests when the rendered page is unnecessary.

candidates.fallback: If public network use is not approved or retrieval fails, report the explicit NOT_RUN or acquisition status and consult an appropriately pinned NOAA snapshot. Never label a cached snapshot as a live check or convert missing rows to zero.

negative_controls: Missing --allow-public-network makes no request and emits no result.
Reject arbitrary URL keys, duplicate JSON keys, Boolean years, wrong schema versions, reversed/out-of-range bounds, and ranges over 50 years before network access.

Only gml.noaa.gov and the fixed HTTPS raw-table path are contacted; redirects, non-text, oversized/slow data, wrong-species markers, malformed rows, duplicate/out-of-order years, and invalid uncertainties fail closed.
Missing source years remain PARTIAL_DATA or NO_MATCH; no emissions estimate or scientific claim is produced.
The identity projection keeps this optional candidate non-selectable by automatic routing; this isolated integration changes no router.

router_conditions: Remain excluded unless the exact candidate ID is explicitly allowlisted for a task requesting values from the NOAA global annual atmospheric N2O raw table only.
Require the typed route profile to list gml.noaa.gov explicitly; route planning does not grant network or execution permission.
Every actual CLI call separately requires --allow-public-network and a task-specific decision to make this public request.
Do not select this adapter for page/raw comparison, emissions inventories, causal analysis, or other gas species.
candidates.claim_ceiling: Provider-reported NOAA GML global annual atmospheric N2O mole-fraction increase and stated uncertainty for selected years from the fixed raw table only; not emissions, attribution, causal analysis, source authentication, or scientific validation.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Retrieve a bounded N2O annual-growth series from one fixed raw table with one explicit public GET, without the additional rendered-page request required by the N2O two-surface comparator.

comparison_evidence.scope: This isolated source package retains matched real-task and C1 records for the six NOAA CO2, CH4, and N2O tools. Comparisons are by species, endpoint surface, request count, and output contract only; they do not rank accuracy, reliability, latency, monetary cost, or scientific validity.
findings: The N2O lookup returns values and uncertainty from its species-specific NOAA table and units; the other gas readers cover different endpoints and cannot satisfy this task contract.
The same-gas page/raw comparator is useful only when the task needs both current surfaces and their literal differences; the raw-only lookup uses one request.
Retain the gas-specific readers by task scope. No reliability, accuracy, long-run agreement, cost, or scientific-validity ranking is established.

deprecation_or_retirement_status.basis: Retain this optional raw-only lookup for minimum-sufficient single-surface N2O requests; retain the N2O comparator for two-surface comparison tasks and the CO2/CH4 tools for their distinct species. No existing candidate is retired.

migration_notes: No Current registry or default route migration is made. If a future N2O raw-only tool overlaps this contract, compare the same years and source fields under identical conditions before changing either disposition.
rollback_steps: Remove the optional catalog entry, wrapper, schemas, docs, fixtures, tests, route/source/C1 evidence, and real-task outputs from the isolated branch; regenerate identity cards and TOOLBOX.md. Preserve the historical source digests and comparison rationale if still useful.
